article.headline: Stanford 60, Yale 44
article.story: STANFORD, Calif. -- Jeremy Green scored 11 of his 15 points in the second half before leaving with an injury, helping Stanford beat Yale 60-44 Tuesday night. Josh Owens added 10 points for the Cardinal (7-4), who improved to 6-0 at home and 7-0 against the Bulldogs. Austin Morgan scored 15 points to lead Yale (5-6). Green left the game with just under 6 minutes to play after connecting on his third straight 3-pointer. He appeared to injure his left ankle and remained on the floor for a couple of minutes before limping off. Stanford used a 12-0 run during an eight-minute stretch to pull away from Yale, which held a 37-36 lead with 13:25 left to play. The Bulldogs didn't scored again until 5:28 remained. Jeremiah Kreisberg hit a layup with 5 seconds left in the first half to give Yale a 27-26 lead at intermission.
